summary.intent: Autonomously run the full post-execute-phase ship loop (verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit → ship → resolve PR reviews → extract learnings) for CipherBox phase 69 (FUSE/WinFsp Rust integration + grant-root awareness), with a user-added hard gate requiring the full Desktop E2E CI matrix (macOS/Windows/Linux) green before merge.
summary.outcome: All standard gates passed (verify/secure/validate, 476 cargo tests, CodeRabbit+Greptile threads resolved, PR #594 opened and all PR CI green including cargo-windows); the Desktop E2E hard gate caught a real cross-language bug (file_iv hex-vs-base64 mismatch) that was root-caused and fixed, plus a Windows-only test-helper migration; session ended mid-confirmation of the final desktop-e2e re-run after the last fix.

repo: Full Desktop E2E CI (desktop-e2e.yml) is workflow_dispatch-gated and does not run automatically on PR pushes — it must be explicitly dispatched via `gh workflow run "Desktop E2E Tests" --ref <branch>` to serve as a merge gate.

Repo squash-merges PRs, so branch-commit subject format doesn't reach release-please post-merge; pr-release-preview.js's commit regex tolerates parens in the description and skips merge commits, making the planned filter-branch reword step unnecessary when commits are already `type(scope):` conventional.
gsd-verify-work's default skill flow is conversational human UAT, not suited for autonomous shipping of CI-gated Rust phases — need to generate the goal-backward VERIFICATION.md directly instead.
CodeRabbit CLI times out summarizing very large diffs (~125 files/24k lines); scope reviews with `--dir` per crate/package to get real results.
clippy is not CI-gated in this repo; most clippy warnings are pre-existing or in vendored code, so a repo-wide clippy cleanup is out of scope for a phase diff.

NodeContent.file_iv was published as hex by the Rust FUSE mount but decoded as base64 by the TS/web node/v3 read chain — caused every cross-client content read to fail with 'Decryption failed'. The cross-language KAT sample IV (000102...0b) is coincidentally valid as both hex and base64, so it never caught the divergence; stale docs/METADATA_SCHEMAS.md said 'hex'.
tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/bump-ipns-sequence.ts was missed by the 69-25 node/v3 migration and still used the legacy folder model (`folder.metadata.children`), crashing under node/v3 vaults.

@cipherbox/core is not re-exported by sdk-core; scripts under tests/desktop-e2e that need core-level functions (unsealNode, Node types) must declare it as a direct devDependency rather than relying on sdk-core's transitive resolution.
Commit commands can report a timeout/hang due to 1Password SSH signing even when the commit actually lands — always verify with `git log --oneline -1` rather than retrying blindly.
zsh treats `$status` as a read-only special variable — using it as a custom variable name in poll scripts silently breaks them.

code.finding: file_iv wire format fixed from hex to base64 to match the TS/web node/v3 contract (publish_file_node and fetch_and_decrypt_content_async), resolving the cross-client 'Decryption failed' bug.

is_unresolved predicate duplicated the enclosing cid.is_empty() check, making the pending_content/empty-file fallback unreachable — caused EIO on read-after-write for locally-buffered files; fixed by serving pending_content before the poll.

fetch_node_gated's own-resolve deliberately compares the stored floor against itself (not the fetched node's generation) by design — a faithful port of the TS dfsFindFolder rule; adversarially verified safe because IPNS records are signature-bound and rollback is still caught via seq gating.

Migrated from legacy folder model (loadVaultKeyBlob().rootFolderKey, folder.metadata.children, updateFolderMetadataAndPublish) to node/v3 (unsealNode, root write-body key, republish at seq+1), mirroring 69-25's edit-filepointer.mts pattern.

workflow: For large/risky phases, scope CodeRabbit CLI reviews per-directory and adversarially verify each finding with independent verification agents before applying fixes, rather than blind-applying suggestions — especially in crypto/concurrency-sensitive code where AI reviewers often misread invariants.
Run heavy test suites (full cargo workspace) centrally from the orchestrator rather than farming them out to parallel subagents, to avoid RAM contention.
When a user adds a new hard gate mid-session (full Desktop E2E matrix), update task tracking immediately and treat it as blocking merge sign-off alongside existing CI checks.
When a stalled/failed subagent leaves no output, don't blindly re-spawn a long-running agent — reconstruct the report manually from already-gathered evidence if it's faster and lower-risk.

Poll for slow external state (CI checks, agent completions) via backgrounded commands rather than busy-waiting, and re-check results with corrected parsing rather than assuming a failed parse means failure.

friction: CodeRabbit CLI timed out summarizing the full 125-file/24k-line diff; had to fall back to directory-scoped reviews.
gsd-security-auditor subagent stalled mid-stream ('Response stalled mid-stream') after ~7.5 minutes without writing SECURITY.md, requiring manual report assembly.
CodeRabbit's apps/desktop-scoped review got rate-limited on the free tier (46-minute wait), deferring that scope to the PR-level review.
Commit helper reported apparent timeouts/failures (1Password SSH signing hang) that were false negatives — required verifying git log each time instead of retrying.
A background poll script failed because it used `$status`, a read-only zsh variable.
GitHub GraphQL mutations (reply/resolve review threads) failed silently multiple times due to API flakiness, requiring retries with visible error output to diagnose.
A cargo-windows check-status poll initially mis-parsed tab-delimited output (space-split grabbed wrong field).
`gh` log retrieval for a failed CI step came back empty because logs were still flushing.
Desktop E2E CI runs take ~30-45 minutes each, requiring multiple dispatch/poll cycles (initial run, post-69-14 run, post-file_iv-fix run, post-bump-helper-migration run) to fully validate.
